info.title: Flood Rescue Resource Allocation Platform API
info.description: REST API for citizen rescue request intake, spatial proximity deduplication, and operator-committed resource dispatching during active flood emergencies.

get.description: Retrieves assignment plans filtered by status or scenario ID.

401.description: Operator authentication required or session expired

post.description: Runs deterministic allocation solver on stored platform data (unassigned requests, available resources, safe shelters) to produce an assignment proposal. Preserves frozen committed stops if requested. The proposal is strictly PROPOSED and is never committed or dispatched autonomously.

201.description: Allocation proposal generated successfully with status PROPOSED

401.description: Operator authentication required or session expired

get.description: Retrieves complete assignment plan including reconstructed vehicle routes, individual route stops, unserved requests with explicit reasons, and performance metrics.

401.description: Operator authentication required or session expired

post.description: Human operator commits a PROPOSED assignment plan. Transitions status to COMMITTED, permanently freezes all route stops (is_frozen = true), and marks all served requests as ASSIGNED. Already committed plans cannot be re-committed.

200.description: Plan committed successfully and stops frozen

401.description: Operator authentication required or session expired

409.description: Plan is already committed or resource/request conflict detected (ALREADY_COMMITTED, REQUEST_ALREADY_ASSIGNED, RESOURCE_ALREADY_COMMITTED)

patch.description: Allows an operator to modify a route stop (toggle freeze status, change stop sequence number, or reassign resource) on a PROPOSED plan. Modifications on COMMITTED plans are rejected.

401.description: Operator authentication required or session expired

409.description: Cannot modify stops on a committed assignment plan (CANNOT_MODIFY_COMMITTED)

get.description: Returns paginated audit records with role-based redaction of sensitive metadata. Requires VIEW_AUDIT permission.

401.description: Operator authentication required or session expired

post.description: Verifies operator credentials, enforces rate limiting, and issues a cryptographic session token and HTTP-only cookie.
Revokes active operator session and clears the session cookie.

get.description: Returns profile of currently authenticated operator.
Retrieves external flood forecast and river discharge simulation context for an operational area. Strictly informational context for operator awareness; does not mutate requests or solver dispatch.

parameters.name: forceRefresh
parameters.description: Bypass in-memory cache and fetch fresh from upstream provider

400.description: Validation error on coordinates or query parameters

get.description: Returns service operational health status and timestamp.
Returns the complete OpenAPI 3.1 specification for the platform API.
Retrieves paginated, filtered log of operational lifecycle events. Requires VIEW_EVENTS permission.

401.description: Operator authentication required or session expired

get.description: Retrieves a single operational event. Requires VIEW_EVENTS permission.

401.description: Operator authentication required or session expired

get.summary: Evaluate planning scope affected by event
get.description: Computes candidate requests, resources, and mutable proposals without mutating assignments. Requires VIEW_EVENTS permission.

401.description: Operator authentication required or session expired

post.description: Orchestrates incremental plan repair from an operational event. Returns 503 REPAIR_ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE in Phase 5 Part 1. Requires REQUEST_REPAIR permission.

401.description: Operator authentication required or session expired

patch.description: Changes status of a rescue resource, emits RESOURCE_OFFLINE or RESOURCE_AVAILABLE, and evaluates affected scope. Requires MANAGE_RESOURCE_STATUS permission.

401.description: Operator authentication required or session expired

post.summary: Record operator-managed hazard or road closure
post.description: Creates a persistent blocked zone, emits ROAD_BLOCKED event, and evaluates affected scope. Requires MANAGE_BLOCKED_ZONES permission.

201.description: Hazard zone created and event emitted

401.description: Operator authentication required or session expired

delete.description: Deactivates a hazard zone, emits ROAD_REOPENED event, and evaluates affected scope. Requires MANAGE_BLOCKED_ZONES permission.

200.description: Hazard zone deactivated and event emitted

401.description: Operator authentication required or session expired

post.description: Citizen rescue request intake with geographic coordinate validation, idempotency caching, spatial-temporal duplicate detection (within 100m, 2 hours, ±2 people), and unverified request retention.

200.description: Idempotent replay: request was previously processed with this idempotency key

400.description: Validation error (out-of-bounds coordinates, non-positive people count, invalid urgency)

409.description: Idempotency key reused with different request payload (IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED)

get.description: Retrieves stored rescue requests with filtering by status, urgency, verification status, duplicate flags, bounding box, and pagination.

401.description: Operator authentication required or session expired

get.description: Fetches a single rescue request by its unique identifier.

401.description: Operator authentication required or session expired

post.description: Cancels an unassigned or pending rescue request and emits REQUEST_CANCELLED. Requires either operator authentication or matching idempotencyKey proof of ownership. Rejects with 409 if request is committed to an active mission.

reason.example: Water receded, no longer in danger

idempotencyKey.description: Original idempotency key submitted by citizen as proof of ownership when cancelling without operator auth

401.description: Unauthorized: missing operator authentication or idempotency key

403.description: Forbidden: idempotency key does not match request

409.description: Cannot cancel request tied to committed assignment

blockedZones.description: Optional request-scoped polygon hazard zones (blocked, water surge, caution)

BearerAuth.description: Operator cryptographic session token issued by POST /auth/login

CookieAuth.name: floodrelay_session
CookieAuth.description: HTTP-only session cookie set by POST /auth/login
